The **Shenandoah National Park**, **Shenandoah Nation Park**, [1] or **Shenandoah Nat'l Park** [2] is a location in Virginia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The Steel Jack Statues throughout Skyline Valley are dedicated to the young men in the Civilian Conservation Corps who built Shenandoah National Park's infrastructure. [3] An entrance sign displays Shenandoah National Park entrance fees, including Motorcycles ($78.50) and Annual Park Passes ($398.99).

Shenandoah National Park appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The location was announced in December 2023 as a southern expansion to the existing map of Appalachia. [Dev 1] 

1. ↑ Special Visit Itinerary
2. ↑ Vault-Tech Supply Order
3. ↑ Fallout 76 loading screens: *"The Steel Jacks throughout Skyline Valley are dedicated to the young men in the Civilian Conservation Corps who built much of Shenandoah National Park's infrastructure.* "

1. ↑ Jonathan Rush: *"Later in 2024, we're expanding our map southward, deep into the wooded heartland of Shenandoah. This uncharted, once-tranquil expanse in the heart of Virginia will bring a new questline, factions and rewards."*
(Fallout 76 in 2024 - A New Year Approaches!)
